m: साभापत mfn. (fr. सभा-पति) g. अश्वपत्य्-आदि.
साभासंनयन mfn. (fr. सभा-स्˚), Pat. on Pāṇ. i, 1, 73, Vārtt. 2.
साभाव्य n. (fr. स-भाव) homogeneousness, identity of nature, Bādar.
साभय-दक्षिणम् ind. with the gift of fearlessness or security, Jātakam.
साभिशङ्क mfn. distrustful, suspicious, Jātakam.
साभिचरणिक mfn. possessing the same rules for exorcising or counteracting enchantments, ĀpŚr.
साभिज्ञान (ibc. or अम् ind.), together with tokens of recognition, Megh.; Kathās.
साभिज्ञानम् (अम्), ind.
साभिज्ञान—युत mfn. furnished with tokens of r˚, Pañcad.
साभिकाम mf(आ)n. having affection, loving, affectionate, Nal.
साभिलाष mf(आ)n. having a desire or longing for (loc. acc. with प्रति, or comp.; अम् ind.), Śak.; Kathās.; MārkP.
साभिलाषम् ind.
साभिमान mf(आ)n. having pride, haughty, proud of (loc.; अम् ind.), R.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
causing pride or self-satisfaction, MBh.
self-interested, egoistical (as an action), ŚārṅgP.
साभिमानम् (अम्), ind.
साभिनयम् ind. with dramatic gesture or gesticulations, pantomimically, Śak.
साभिनिवेश mfn. having or attended with a great inclination or predilection for anything, Sāh.
साभिप्राय mfn. having a distinct aim or purpose, persevering, resolute, Kathās.
betraying a certain purpose, intentional, Pañcat.
साभिसंस्कार-परिनिर्वायिन् mfn. (said of a kind of Anāgāmin q.v.), Buddh.
साभिसर mfn. along with followers or companions, Hcar.; Śiś.
साभिताप mfn. suffering pain, distressed, afflicted, Kathās.
साभ्र mfn. having clouds, cloudy, Megh.
साभ्रङ्गिका f. a kind of metre, Col.
साभ्र—मती f. N. of a river flowing through Ahmedābād (commonly ‘Sabermattee’), Śatr.
साभ्र—मती—माहात्म्य m. N. of wk.
साभ्र—वती f. = -मती, Siṃhās.
साभ्रि mfn. together with a hoe or spade, KātyŚr.
साभ्यास mfn. reduplicated, Nir.
साभ्यर्थन mfn. with entreaties, Kād.
साभ्यसूय mfn. envious, malicious, jealous of (loc.; अम् ind.), Ragh.; Śiś.
साभ्यसूयम् ind.
